name: links
title: Links
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Ctrl-click a URL or file path in a terminal to open it.
description: Clients find plain URLs and file paths in terminal panes. Ctrl-click one, or right-click it for the pane menu, and this opens it: a URL with the system's opener (xdg-open, open or start), a file in your $VISUAL or $EDITOR in a split beside the pane, at its line. Set doc/settings/links {opener, editor} to choose other programs. Turn it off and links do nothing; nothing ever opens without your click.

works_with.without: Files do not open (they open in a split)

keys: Ctrl-click a link in a terminal: open it
